Clause-②: no

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用 AI 助手搭看板的应用作者,拿到的看板配置会带上每条泳道底部的统计(计数、合计、平均、最小、最大),以及卡片上「是否显示字段名」「是否隐藏空字段」两个开关;此前助手只会写旧的求和写法。
- 为什么做:这是「看板视图有了自己的设置」这项工作的收尾,技能文档此前没有教这些新设置。
- 出错会怎样:助手会照着错的说明去写看板配置;本次只改文字,可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`, section "Configuring Kanban Views":

- The board example writes `kanban.summary` (`{ type: 'sum', field: 'estimate_hours' }`) in place of `summarizeField`, and sets `showFieldLabels` and `hideEmptyFields`, each with its default (`true`) in the trailing comment.
- One note under the example: the six `summary.type` values (`none`, `count`, `sum`, `avg`, `min`, `max`); the four aggregates take a `field` and are computed by the query over every record of the lane, not only the loaded cards; the known gap the spec names (lanes over a lookup field, or a view with grouping: `sum` covers one fetched page and the other three show nothing); `summary` takes precedence over the older sum-only `summarizeField`.
- `summarizeField` is still an accepted key (`KanbanConfigSchema` in `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` declares it, no tombstone, no conversion), so it is named once as the older spelling and no longer taught as the way to write a lane statistic. No other file under `skills/` mentions it (`git grep summarizeField -- skills` at this head: one hit, the new note).

Every sentence was written from the spec's describe text and JSDoc for `KanbanLaneSummarySchema`, `summary`, `showFieldLabels` and `hideEmptyFields` at main a68b475bbc.

### Paid for in the same file

The file had 4 bytes of token headroom, so the new teaching is paid by cutting restatement in `list-views.md` itself. No ratchet row moves.

| Cut | Restates |
|:---|:---|
| search example comment "No `searchableFields` ..." | the "key omitted" row of the table below it |
| search example comment "This list only ..." | the `searchableFields` line under it |
| "The full `dropdown / tabs / toggle` range applies only to page lists ..." | "`tabs` is page-only" in the same bullet |
| "the whole search box, for every user and every term: no result at all" | its own heading, "One bad entry 400s EVERY search on that list" |
| "errors, not warnings" | "fails the build" in the same sentence |
| comment "no search box" | the sentence introducing the example |
| "one lane per option" on `groupByField` | the `lanes` note under the example |
| "the default `list` and every other view untouched" | "a NEW `listViews` entry that coexists with the views the object has" |
| gantt comments "task bar start" / "task bar end" | the key names `startDateField` / `endDateField` |

## Tests

Head 7d7ca6db24. Text only: no tested behaviour changes, so no ablation.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` (spec and the client-react closure built first, under the verify lock): exit 0, "350 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)". This is the gate that type-checks the board example against `ListView`.
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0, "skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md is 4444 tokens (ceiling 4448; headroom 4)".

## Acceptance notes

- Card acceptance: the board example uses all three keys the board gained (`summary`, `showFieldLabels`, `hideEmptyFields`); the scope addition's three statistics (`avg`, `min`, `max`) are named with what they cover.
- No eval case was added. No case in `evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` exercises these keys, and a case was drafted, but `scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` answered exit 1 against open PR #37043, which appends to the same file. The case was dropped so this branch does not queue behind that pull (overlap-check at this head: `VERDICT clean exit 0`). A case for the lane statistic can follow once that pull lands.
- The example sets `showFieldLabels: false` and `hideEmptyFields: false`, the non-default values, so the keys are visible in the example; the comments carry the defaults.
